title: Long-Odds Lab
one_liner: Explore how '8x more likely' claims about foreign-born, dropout and adopted tech CEOs are calculated from base rates.
headline: Drag two sliders to see why the podcast's '8x more likely' claim about foreign-born tech CEOs doesn't actually equal 60% ÷ 14%.

episode.title: Thanksgiving Special: The Moments That Almost Ended Us (And Why We’re Grateful) | EP #316

history.summary: A tightly-scoped, honest stats explainer that does exactly what the idea brief asked: live representation vs. odds ratios, a sample-size-driven uncertainty band, and a clear, unresolved explanation of the 8x vs. 4.3x gap. Every number on screen traces back to a verified IDEA.json figure or a clearly-labeled derived/illustrative calculation, and all five acceptance criteria hold up under the code and screenshots. It's a bit dry and keeps its real payoff below the fold, but it's clean, self-contained, and faithful enough to show the hosts without embarrassment.
